walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Start using ParadoxCode
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: A guided setup for your first EU4 Mod. Marketplace users normally need no manual server configuration.
walkthrough.trustWorkspace.title: Trust the Mod workspace
walkthrough.trustWorkspace.description: ParadoxCode runs the language server only in a trusted workspace. Choose [Trust this workspace](command:workbench.trust.manage), then return here.
walkthrough.openMod.title: Open your Mod folder
walkthrough.openMod.description: Open the folder that contains your Mod's common, events, decisions, history, missions, or localisation directories with [Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder). You do not need to create a project file first.
walkthrough.prepareServer.title: Let ParadoxCode prepare pdx-ls
walkthrough.prepareServer.description: The extension downloads and checksum-verifies the matching pdx-ls release automatically. Wait for the PDX ● status item. If it stays ○, retry [Install or Update pdx-ls](command:paradoxcode.installServer) or inspect [Output](command:paradoxcode.openOutput).
walkthrough.vanillaData.title: Enable Vanilla symbols
walkthrough.vanillaData.description: ParadoxCode builds a local Vanilla index in the background so completion, hover, and navigation can see the base game. Automatic discovery is tried first. If it cannot find EU4, choose [EU4 Installation / Vanilla Data](command:paradoxcode.selectGameDirectory) and select the folder containing eu4.exe plus common, events, missions, decisions, and localisation. The server validates the folder and retries without another setup file.
walkthrough.checkDiagnostics.title: Check your first diagnostics
walkthrough.checkDiagnostics.description: Open an EU4 script file and look at the Problems panel. Diagnostics update as you edit. For a shareable snapshot, run [Export Workspace Diagnostics](command:paradoxcode.exportDiagnostics).
walkthrough.missionPreview.title: Preview a mission tree
walkthrough.missionPreview.description: Open a file under common/missions, then run [Open Mission Tree Preview](command:paradoxcode.showMissionPreview) from the editor title bar or Command Palette. The preview is read-only and renders geometry supplied by pdx-ls.

configuration.pdxLsPath.description: Path to the pdx-ls server binary. When empty, ParadoxCode checks the downloaded cache and PATH.
configuration.serverInstallDirectory.des: Advanced: directory for checksum-verified pdx-ls downloads. Empty uses VS Code global storage.
configuration.modDirectory.description: Directory of the current Mod. Defaults to the workspace root.
configuration.vanillaIndexCache.descript: Path to a persistent Vanilla index cache (.pdxindex).
configuration.dependencies.description: Dependency Mods from lowest to highest priority. Each item is { id, path, index? }.
configuration.gameDirectory.description: EU4 installation root containing eu4.exe. Used for mission textures and as the explicit Vanilla source during guided setup.
configuration.workspaceWideDiagnostics.d: Publish diagnostics for closed files in the current Mod during workspace validation and refreshes.
configuration.backgroundReindexIntervalM: Quiet full workspace re-scan interval in minutes. Zero disables automatic re-scans.
configuration.backgroundReindexIdleSecon: Minimum editor-idle time before a quiet workspace re-scan can begin.
configuration.ignoreFilePatterns.descrip: Glob patterns for files excluded from workspace discovery.
configuration.ignoreDirectories.descript: Glob patterns for directories excluded from workspace discovery.
configuration.diagnosticIgnoreCodes.desc: Diagnostic codes to hide in the VS Code Problems view.
configuration.diagnosticIgnoreFiles.desc: Workspace-relative diagnostic file globs to hide, for example **/README.txt.
configuration.diagnosticLogging.descript: Write diagnostic filtering counts to the ParadoxCode output channel.
configuration.server.installPolicy.descr: Controls whether the matching pdx-ls release may be downloaded when no server is found.
Download and checksum-verify the matching server automatically.
configuration.server.installPolicy.promp: Ask before downloading; offer install, binary selection, or output actions.
configuration.server.installPolicy.never: Never download automatically; use pdxLsPath, the cache, or PATH.
configuration.vanilla.mode.description: Controls how Vanilla symbols are sourced for this workspace.
configuration.vanilla.mode.auto.descript: Use configured caches and the normal automatic discovery/build path.
configuration.vanilla.mode.cacheOnly.des: Use an available cache but do not discover or build a new cache automatically.
configuration.vanilla.mode.disabled.desc: Do not load or build Vanilla symbols for this workspace.
configuration.diagnostics.severityOverri: Map diagnostic codes to effective severities. Use off to suppress a code.
configuration.localisation.preferredLang: Language order for localisation hover and mission titles, for example english, french, german.
configuration.completion.sourceLayers.de: Source layers allowed to contribute completion members. Resolution priority remains fixed.
configuration.performance.profile.descri: Bounded workspace scanning profile controlling parser concurrency.
configuration.performance.profile.balanc: Use the default bounded concurrency for ordinary workspaces.
configuration.performance.profile.conser: Use fewer workers to reduce CPU and memory pressure.
configuration.performance.profile.fast.d: Use the maximum bounded worker count for faster scans.
configuration.preview.showTextures.descr: Use EU4 frame and icon textures when available in Mission Preview.
configuration.preview.refreshMode.descri: Controls when the Mission Preview requests fresh layout data.
configuration.preview.refreshMode.always: Refresh after edits with a short debounce.
configuration.preview.refreshMode.onSave: Refresh when the active mission document is saved.
configuration.preview.refreshMode.manual: Refresh only when the preview refresh command or button is used.
configuration.preview.persistViewport.de: Remember the preview pan and zoom between payload updates and panel reopenings.
configuration.preview.showExternalPrereq: Show prerequisite missions that live outside the current mission file.
configuration.preview.showDiagnostics.de: Show diagnostic counts, badges, colors, and entries in the preview.
configuration.preview.defaultExportDirec: Default directory for mission preview PNG, SVG, and JSON exports. Relative paths use the workspace root.
